title: Exotic Crisp Dongbei Rice Lo Meen
description: A nutty and crisp Chinese dish featuring paella rice, perfect for a date night, this shojin-friendly lo-mein is cooked to perfection in a copper pot.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a copper pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced scallions and cook until they are lightly browned.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender.
Add the paella rice to the pot and stir to combine with the scallions and mushrooms.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Stir in the pitted dates and toasted sesame seeds.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the dates are heated through.
Serve the Exotic Crisp Dongbei Rice Lo Meen hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
